title: Small-Scale Solar-Powered Irrigation Pumping Systems
lineage: Prepared for a UNDP project executed by the World Bank; the cited section is inspected in a full digitized scan.

passages.note: The report describes Shuman and Boys installing a solar-powered irrigation pumping engine near Cairo in 1913, and identifies earlier Mouchot and Pifre solar-steam work. The scan reads the Maadi rating as 50 hp; reports vary, so no output measure used.
